title: Kaash roze ashoora
body:
haye yateemi haye aseeri
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein sakina ye keh rahi thi ro ro kar
kaash roze ashoora mai bhi mar gayi hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
roz dam nikalta na is tarha se ghut ghut kar
kaash roze ashoora mai bhi mar gayi hoti
<<DIVIDER>>
jo chacha mujhe meri jaan se bhi pyara tha
meri pyaas ki khaatir khoon beh gaya uska
mai nisaar ho jaati kaash apne ammu par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maine apne ammu ka khoon mein tar alam dekha
naujawan bhai ka aaya saamne laasha
mujhko maut aayi na mar gaya mera asghar
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zulm ka woohi khanjar mujhpe chal gaya hota
kaash us ghadi mera dam nikal gaya hota
shimr jab chadha mere baba jaan ke seene par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
cheen li layeeno ne jis ghadi rida meri
dono haath chehre par rakh ke mai bohat roye
ye sada niklti thi mere dil se reh reh kar
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne tamachon se jis ghadi mujhe maara
roye nok e naiza par phoot kar mere baba
ye churi nahi chalti baba jaan ke dil par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono kaan zakhmi hai dono gaal neele hai
kya yateem bacchon par aise zulm hote hai
kaun tha taras khaata jo meri yateemi par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko jab kaneezi mein ek layeen ne maanga
soch kar yehi us dam mera dil bohat roya
mai ali ki poti hoon aur ye sitam mujh par
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala mein gar meri nafz tham gayi hoti
mai bhi apne baba ke paas qabr mein soti
wo wahan tadapte na aur mai qaid ke andar
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haal aamir o waiz kya kahe yateema ka
qaid e shaam mein jis dam ghamzada ka dam nikla
maut ki har ek hichki le rahi thi ye keh kar
kaash roze ashoora...
qaid mein sakina ye...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
